answer: Identities board from a single jetty: each wallet files identities in nonce order, so a new fake must wait behind every earlier one before its haven pledge unlocks. Fake identity 1 waits 1 hour at 5 credits per hour of forgone reward. The nth fake waits n hours, so N fakes cost N(N+1)/2 hours: ten cost 275 credits, a hundred cost 25,250. The queue cannot be parallelised because one wallet has one nonce chain, so cost grows quadratically as the horizon of the sybil fleet widens.
